description: SequentialFrameW surface hidden (gate-off, honest undrivable case). Sequential arrow-frame drawing is driven by navigation data that arrives only through the someIP service (RecommendedDrivingDirectionsId, ethHudRoadInfoNotifyOnLine, arNavData_s); it cannot be set through the can[]/mem[] harness fields exposed for this surface. The arrow-frame Draw body therefore cannot be reached with a drivable SHOW input on this simulator. This case holds the surface at its non-show state and asserts the negative label, documenting SequentialFrameW as undrivable until the navigation someip path is re-based.

can.desc: HUD master switch frame ON (on-topic; surface is not drivable to show)
